definitions.gloss: chest area; bosom; the area around the upper chest and neckline
definitions.explanation: The front of the body around the upper chest, especially where clothing opens or closes. Often refers to the area visible at the neckline of clothing.

examples.japanese: {胸元|むなもと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{開|あ}いた→開く：00689_aku⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧。
{胸元|むなもと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ブローチ→ブローチ：04894_buroochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけた→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I pinned a brooch to my chest.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}くて→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧、⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{胸元|むなもと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧はだけてしまった。
examples.english: The wind was so strong that the front of my kimono came open.

notes:
Composed of {胸|むな} (chest) + ⟦{元|もと}→元：03878_moto⟧ (area around). Refers specifically to the upper chest area, especially as it relates to clothing — the neckline, the opening of a shirt or kimono, or the area where accessories are worn.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {胸元|むなもと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|あ}く→開く：00689_aku⟧: the neckline is open
- {胸元|むなもと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧はだける: the chest area comes undone
- {胸元|むなもと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{正|ただ}す→正す：10132_tadasu⟧: to straighten one's collar/clothing
- {胸元|むなもと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{当|あ}てる→当てる：01864_ateru⟧: to put one's hand to one's chest

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{胸|むね}→胸：00972_mune⟧: chest — the general body part; {胸元|むなもと} focuses on the surface and clothing area
- ⟦{襟元|えりもと}→襟元：17004_erimoto⟧: collar area — specifically the area around the collar of clothing
- ⟦{喉元|のどもと}→喉元：22093_nodomoto⟧: throat area — the front of the neck, slightly higher than {胸元|むなもと}
